questions.s:
Arrange the following in order of decreasing magnetic moments:
Fe2+ Mn2+ Cu2+ V3+
questions.x: Magnetic moment rises with unpaired electrons: Mn2+ (3d5) has 5, Fe2+ (3d6) 4, V3+ (3d2) 2 and Cu2+ (3d9) 1.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Which of the following is/are correct about sigma bond?
1) Formed by axial overlapping
2) Weaker
3) Independent existence
4) Free rotation possible
questions.x: A sigma bond forms by head-on (axial) overlap, can exist on its own and allows free rotation; it is stronger, not weaker, than a pi bond.

questions.s:
Which statement is not true about India's National Flag?
a) The ratio of the length and width of the flag is 2: 1
b) It is designed using three colours - saffron (top most), white (middle) and India green (lower most). The middle band contains navy blue Ashoka Chakra (Wheel of Law) in the centre with 24 spokes to the wheel.
c) The present form of the national flag was adopted in the meeting of Constituent Assembly on 22nd of July in 1947.
d) It is also called as 'Tiranga', meaning three colours and is based on Swaraj flag, designed by PingaliVenkayya.
questions.x: The national flag's length-to-width ratio is 3:2, not 2:1, so statement a is false.
